resources.string: grod notices when you open or scroll the apps listed in its rules, such as Instagram, YouTube and TikTok. When one opens it asks what it is for, and after a while of scrolling it shows a pause screen that grows longer each time. It does not read the screen: it only learns that an app came to the front or scrolled, and sends nothing anywhere.
Covers Instagram’s Explore recommendations while leaving search available. Grod checks Instagram’s view IDs and positions on this device. It does not read or save text, images, or messages.
